concerns.text: FR-001 (synthetic trajectory generation with controlled density) has no associated task tag or description in tasks.md.
FR-002 (agent simulation with configurable retention horizon) is not linked to any task; no task explicitly implements the required success definition.
FR-003 (logistic regression with natural splines) lacks a dedicated task; analysis tasks T018‑T019c cover analysis but are not tagged to FR-003.
FR-004 (3‑D surface plot generation) is not referenced by any task; visualization task T037 exists but is not linked to FR-004.
FR-005 (CPU‑only execution with ≤7 GB RAM and ≤14 GB disk) is not covered by any explicit resource‑budget task.
FR-006 (summary report of regression coefficients) has no matching task; no task generates the required report file.
FR-007 (density metric must be independent of agent output) is not validated by any task; no task asserts this decoupling.
FR-008 (composite density formula with weighted entropy > technical‑ratio) is not tied to any task; no task verifies the weighting.
FR-009 (heuristic solver probability = sigmoid(α × (density − threshold))) is not reflected in any task; simulation tasks use a different distance‑based heuristic.
FR-010 (sensitivity analysis over density weights and α values) is completely missing from tasks.md.
SC-001 (interaction term significance measurement) is not covered by any verification task.
SC-002 (PNG surface plot must exist and be ≤ 5 MB) has no task that checks file size or existence.
SC-003 (pipeline runtime ≤ free‑tier CI time limit) is not measured or asserted by any task.
SC-004 (peak memory usage ≤ 7 GB) is not validated; only T015 checks a hard memory limit but does not record actual usage.
SC-005 (≥ 500 trajectories generated) is not explicitly verified; T011 generates trajectories but does not assert the exact count or balance.
No contract test task validates the `trajectory.schema.yaml`; only T016 validates simulation output schema.
No task validates the `simulation_result.schema.yaml`; contract coverage is incomplete.
The quickstart guide is updated in T043, but there is no task that tests the quickstart steps end‑to‑end.
Phase 0 scaffolding tasks are marked completed, yet no task verifies that the directory tree and quickstart file actually exist.
Phase 5 compliance & hand‑off tasks (T041‑T044) exist, but there is no task that checks that the final report correctly references all generated artifacts per the constitution.
